question:
List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: followed up at the outpatient clinic refers to Admission = '-'; laboratory test in April 1981 refers to Date like '1991-10%'; blood bilirubin level within the normal range refers to T-BIL < 2.0;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.XCL_058
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE e.XCL_006 = 'outpatient'
  AND l.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-31'
  AND l.XCL_020 BETWEEN l.XCL_021 AND l.XCL_022

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
WHERE P.XCL_063 = '-'
  AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.XCL_025 < 2.0;
